parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The updated business type. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to add remarks for specific business scenarios, such as different facial recognition usage scenarios or customer identifiers for pending deliveries.

parameters.name: DeviceId
parameters.description: The unique ID generated by the ID Verification server for the device of the requester. This ID is generated only after the device is successfully activated. You can obtain this ID by calling the getLicenseExtraInfo function in the offline facial recognition SDK.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The period by which to extend the device expiration time. Unit: years. Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 100 indicates permanent use. One year is calculated as 365 days.

parameters.name: ExpiredDay
parameters.description:
The expiration time of the current device. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect (differs from the expiration time recorded on the ID Verification server by more than one week).
> You can query the expiration time by calling the DescribeDeviceInfo operation. An error is returned if the expiration date is incorrect. This validation ensures that the requester does not accidentally reactivate a device due to misoperations, which would unnecessarily consume authorization quotas.

parameters.name: UserDeviceId
parameters.description: The updated user device ID. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is defined by the requester and can be used to identify a specific device. We recommend that you use the physical device number.
